title: Questions and Replies between Tang Taizong and Li Weigong (English)
summary: A complete English reading of the Tang Li wendui: three scrolls, fifty exchanges, 197 speeches, 10,292 characters. One of the Seven Military Classics, the only one from the Tang and the only one cast throughout as dialogue — the emperor who won the empire in the field questioning Li Jing, the general who took the Eastern Turks. Its subjects are the unorthodox and the orthodox, the full and the empty, host and guest, attack and defence. Collated character by character against the Wenyuan ge Siku quanshu text, with the decisive readings checked by eye against a plain-text woodblock edition held by the Shanghai Library; twelve emendations, 103 variants recorded.
